items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember Jimmy Noon? Did you ever play with Jimmy Noon... [INTERVIEWEE] Jimbo. Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Just like the Bob Rands, the two brothers of drummers.
Mm-hmm. Yeah, the two of them. You remember Jimmy Noon? Did you ever play with Jimmy Noon, a young clarinet player in those days? He went to Chicago.
